# The rule: every species Kew accepts with a cultivated record, counted as the list counts them (iNaturalist observations marked captive or cultivated, and GBIF living-specimen records of the datasets the dataset rule counts, added together), that scripts/species-list.txt and scripts/species-added.txt do not hold. Ranked by its records (more first), then its iNaturalist observations (more first), then Kew's name. A species with 3 or more is one whose records reached the list's bar after the list was made. build-dossiers.ts --grow N appends the next N to scripts/species-added.txt, each with its counts and "queued, added <day>".

(scripts/counted-datasets.txt, excluded-datasets.txt and undecided-datasets.txt list every dataset and why.)
